## Problem

What are you trying to do that Lattice DOE currently can't (or makes hard)?
Concrete experimental-design scenarios help most.

## Proposed behavior

What would the API/CLI/UI look like? A sketch of the call you wish you
could write:

```python
result = find_optimal_design(..., new_option=...)
```

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you tried, or why existing options (see `docs/user-guide.md`
and the backlog in `docs/planning/ENHANCEMENTS.md`) don't fit.
